one_line: 12th‑century Chandela ruler of Mahoba and Khajuraho, remembered for sustaining Bundelkhand with engineered tanks and water systems.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, athletic and wiry with the calm strength of a seasoned ruler-engineer.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-deep brown complexion, straight nose, neatly kept short mustache and trimmed beard along the jawline, a small sandalwood tilak at the center of the forehead, and a default expression of focused, thoughtful determination as if planning works.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair gathered into a medium-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothly combed back, held with a simple narrow gold band; he wears a plain, narrow golden circlet resting high on the forehead, without large ornaments.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic wrapping left over right with a subtle woven border, over which is a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton-and-silk vest in muted maroon with simple vertical stitching; his lower garment is a deep indigo dhoti of fine cotton, pleated in front and wrapped securely around the waist, ending above the ankles, with a thin maroon border that matches the vest; a light, narrow ochre silk patka (waist sash) is tied at the left hip and falls to mid-thigh; over one shoulder he drapes a soft pale-cream cotton uttariya (shawl) that can be pulled over the head at ritual sites; he is barefoot or in simple brown leather sandals; jewellery is restrained—a pair of small gold kundala earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace close to the neck, a plain signet ring on his right hand, and a slim copper bangle on the left wrist, emphasizing a practical ruler rather than a heavily ornamented court figure.
appearance.signature: A long, straight wooden measuring staff marked with faint carved gradations, carried in his right hand like an engineer’s tool, with a small rolled palm-leaf map tied near the top by a thin cord, symbolizing planning of tanks and embankments.

ref_desc: Madanavarman Chandela is a medium-brown, sharp-cheeked man in his late 30s with a small tilak, black hair in a topknot with a simple gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarkha, maroon quilted vest, deep indigo dhoti, ochre sash, light cream shawl, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a wooden measuring staff with a tied palm-leaf map, in off-white, deep indigo, maroon, ochre and warm gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Madanavarman Chandela: a mid-30s, athletic Bundelkhand ruler with an oval, sharp-cheeked face, medium-deep brown skin, straight nose, small neat mustache and trimmed jawline beard, and a calm, focused expression with a small sandalwood tilak on his forehead. His glossy black hair is pulled into a medium-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothly combed back and held by a narrow golden headband, topped by a plain, narrow golden circlet resting high on the forehead. Dress him in an off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic wrapping left over right with subtle woven borders, over a sleeveless, fitted maroon quilted vest with simple vertical stitching; his lower garment is a deep indigo pleated dhoti ending above the ankles with a thin maroon border, secured by a narrow ochre silk patka sash tied at the left hip and hanging to mid-thigh. A light pale-cream cotton uttariya shawl is draped over one shoulder and across his back, ready to be pulled over his head at sacred sites. Put simple brown leather sandals or bare feet appropriate to a 12th-century Indian king overseeing works, and minimal jewellery—a pair of small gold kundala earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace at the base of the neck, one plain signet ring on his right hand, and a slim copper bangle on his left wrist—to emphasize practicality. In his right hand he holds a long, straight wooden measuring staff with faint carved gradation marks, with a small rolled palm-leaf map tied near the top by a thin cord, symbolizing planning of tanks and embankments. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, maroon, ochre and warm gold, and show front, side and back views to clearly display the consistent face, topknot and circlet, layered garments, sash, shawl drape, and the measuring staff with its tied palm-leaf map.
